agent.notes: check.py does not pass: head coverage is 0.578 (107/185 changed lines) against the 0.8 threshold. Output digests match, the no-network run passes, base takes about 9.3 s. Neither venv imported with the frozen transformers 5.3 (base needs optimum.bettertransformer, which optimum 2.1 dropped; head lacked sentencepiece), and base's forward is incompatible with transformers 5.x. So transformers==4.46.3, optimum==1.23.3 and sentencepiece were installed into both venvs; the measurement runs on 4.46, not the 5.3 the PR targets. The workload builds a small random Llama (8 layers, sharded safetensors under /tmp/kt_268) and runs three CPU forwards through AirLLMLlama2 with different prefetching/profiling settings; the prefetching runs use the library's ThreadPoolExecutor. It uses one model instance per forward because on head under 4.46 a second forward on the same instance fails (the new cleanup moves per-attention rotary buffers to meta). Lines not reached: bitsandbytes quantized loading and CUDA memory sizing (need a GPU), the past_key_values and use_cache branches (forced off when cache_utils is installed), _init_model_fast (never called), and the default init branch (needs a model class without BetterTransformer; a small Mistral model was tried and its forward fails on both versions with a meta-device error).
